namespace_index_policy: Resolve by URI at runtime; do not hardcode an index
security_profile: Unsecured loopback teaching profile only; no production security claim
client_access: Read-only; client writes must be rejected and tested

nodes.meaning: Advances each completed simulated acquisition even if values are unchanged; resets on server restart; not an atomic multi-node snapshot guarantee

unit_metadata: Expose the unit strings above as read-only Unit properties; these custom properties do not claim standard AnalogItemType/EUInformation or companion-specification conformance

timing_assumptions.timeout_clock: Client monotonic time since acquisition sequence last advanced; require progress after connection

mapping.source_ts: Valid OPC UA SourceTimestamp converted from UTC to integer Unix milliseconds; never substitute emit/receive time
mapping.ts: Client emission time in Unix milliseconds
mapping.seq: Collector emission sequence; distinct from acquisition sequence and OPC UA subscription sequence
mapping.good: Finite correctly typed value, valid SourceTimestamp, Good UA status, valid state/fault metadata for this connection and fresh acquisition
mapping.bad_or_uncertain: Suppress current numeric telemetry; record raw status and reason in local diagnostics
mapping.stale: Suppress normal good publication and diagnose acquisition timeout; no fabricated replacement sample
mapping.raw_status: Separate diagnostic record: v2 forbids extra fields
mapping.equipment_state: Use state_map independently of source status or connectivity; unknown codes reject publication
mapping.fault_code: Preserve valid UInt16 equipment code, including unknown codes in diagnostics; do not turn transport failure into equipment fault 999
mapping.snapshot_consistency: No atomic snapshot claim; stage until required metadata validated and acquisition progress observed

source_hashes_purpose: Historical U01 inputs at fb430f5; current runtime hashes are in retained run-02 manifest
